paragraphs: DTN sells forecasting and risk planning for organizations whose operations turn on weather. Refined fuel markets are another line of business, with real-time visibility, pricing and supply chain intelligence.

The products are packaged as vertical hubs tailored to the workflows of a given sector. One is aimed at utilities, where the pitch is outage response and grid reliability. A newer platform turns weather intelligence into safety decisions for live events and sports, universities and schools, public safety and construction teams.

The company states that it is certified for data security and quality. Manuel Zepeda was named chief executive officer. He arrived most recently from Spirent Communications, where he led global sales and services. DTN has also announced work on real-time weather intelligence using NVIDIA Earth-2 on AWS.

quote.text: Precision forecasting and risk planning for aviation, logistics, and utilities.
